# FLX-6005: type mismatch

**Family:** expression language (the 6000 band)

flux-expr/1 has no coercion: the two sides of a comparison must have the same type, and each method is declared on one type only.

## Look it up offline

```console
$ fluxsim explain FLX-6005
```

Every code is listed in the [error index](./README.md).
